verdict.rationale: The documented API covers contacts, lists, fields, campaign reports and starting an automation for a specific contact. Nothing in the evidence shows a transactional send endpoint for one-to-one receipts, magic links or notifications. Triggering a per-contact automation is an adjacent marketing-automation feature, not a transactional email API, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send one-to-one transactional email — receipts, magic links, notifications — through the same platform's API alongside marketing sends
